derivation.method: Retain the source silhouette and transparency, remap opaque pixels into the Project Tarmin outline, ember, warm leather, and parchment tokens, and scale 4x with nearest-neighbor sampling. Fantasy FPS Hands informed pose language only and contributes no runtime pixels.

runtimePolicy: The asset is a presentation-only empty-hands baseline. Equipped items resolve from canonical presentationId metadata but unsupported held-object art falls back to this asset; no torch item or gameplay content is created.
